entries.speaker: adam
entries.text: A password is your secret key. It tells the computer it's really YOU. A weak key? The Raccoon snaps it. A strong key keeps him locked out.
lines: A password is your secret key.
It tells the computer it's really YOU.
A weak key? The Raccoon snaps it.
A strong key keeps him locked out.

entries.speaker: layla
entries.text: The longer the password, the stronger it is. Try three random words. Like otter... rocket... mango! Long, strong, and easy to remember.
lines: The longer the password, the stronger it is.
Try three random words.
Like otter... rocket... mango!
Long, strong, and easy to remember.

entries.speaker: adam
entries.text: Mix it up to make it tough. Big letters, small letters, numbers, symbols. A plain word like 'tiger'? Too easy. Mix it, and the Raccoon's stuck.
lines: Mix it up to make it tough.
Big letters, small letters, numbers, symbols.
A plain word like 'tiger'? Too easy.
Mix it, and the Raccoon's stuck.

entries.speaker: layla
entries.text: A password only works if it's secret. Don't tell your best friend. Don't leave it where people can see. Only a grown-up you trust helps.
lines: A password only works if it's secret.
Don't tell your best friend.
Don't leave it where people can see.
Only a grown-up you trust helps.

entries.speaker: adam
entries.text: The Raccoon guesses the obvious first. Your name? Your birthday? Too easy. 123456? He tries that first. Pick something he'd never guess.
lines: The Raccoon guesses the obvious first.

entries.speaker: layla
entries.text: Look at everything you learned this week! A password is your secret key. Make it long, and mix it up. Keep it secret, and nothing obvious. Time to claim your stickers!
